content:7e77d345dd1ef4b4e87b2eeb90cc0f3e.title: An ‘act of democratic self-harm' was approved by Bury council last night and no one is happy
content:7e77d345dd1ef4b4e87b2eeb90cc0f3e.english_reader_card: Bury Council approved constitutional changes to implement the National Scheme of Delegation, splitting planning applications into two tiers and removing councillors' right to call in applications. content:363e3a6f65c5b8e4889cac50586cba36.english_reader_card: Developer Urban Splash must pay over £45m to the government after fire safety defects were fixed in seven Manchester high-rises, a tribunal ruled.

english_fact_card.what_happened: Developer Urban Splash has been ordered to pay more than £45.7m to the government after fire safety defects were repaired in seven high-rise buildings in Manchester.
